note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Omagh rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Only Glenlark was contested, where an Independent opposed the outgoing Nationalist; 'Twenty-one Unionists and 17 Nationalists for Omagh Rural Council have been returned unopposed' (Strabane Chronicle, 24 May 1952, p. 3, which prints the full list of nominations, labels as printed). Ten new members came in unopposed. Returned unopposed.
